items.caption:
Surah Al-Kahf · Part 1 of 2 · Ayat 1–50
Recited by Maher Al-Muaiqly

The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays (al-Hakim, al-Bayhaqi).

Part 2 (ayat 51–110) follows 10 minutes later on our page.
Listen, read along and share it with someone this Friday 🤍
